src.title: The Best Low Calorie Alfredo Pasta Ever

recipes.title: Low-Calorie Chicken Alfredo (Cauliflower Sauce)

items.i: head cauliflower, cut into even florets
extra Parmigiano and cracked pepper, to serve (optional, not in macros)

steps: Boil the florets in well-salted water for 10–12 minutes, until completely soft and mushy — a fork should slide straight through.

Butterfly each breast and split into thin cutlets, flattening with your palm. Season with salt and pepper. Sear in a lightly sprayed, ripping-hot skillet for 2–3 minutes, flip and cook 3–4 more until 165 °F inside. Rest, then slice into strips.

Lift the cauliflower (no water) into a blender with half the milk, the Parmigiano, Pecorino, garlic, a pinch of salt and the bouillon or MSG. Blend on high until very smooth, adding more milk a splash at a time until it has an Alfredo texture.
Boil the fettuccine in heavily salted water until al dente.
Put some sauce in a pan, add the pasta straight from the water with a little pasta water and toss, adding more sauce and pasta water until creamy. You may have sauce left over.
Twirl a quarter of the pasta into each bowl, top with chicken and, if you like, more Parmigiano and black pepper.
recipes.notes: Amounts are as said in the video; per-serving macros come from the on-screen card (extra cheese on top not included). A lower-carb pasta cuts the calories further.
